modifiers.value: Regiment is automatically managed by the listbuilder and should appear only once. Remove any extra Regiment entries, then select Regiments of Cadia, Death Korps of Krieg, or Mordian Iron Guard on the remaining entry.

selectionEntries.comment: REGIMENT PRESENTATION ABSTRACTION: the source PDF derives regiment identity indirectly from the mutually exclusive Troop choice. The listbuilder surfaces that decision first as an explicit Regiment selector because it is clearer for note-taking. Regiments of Cadia is the default. Regiment selection controls availability only; PDF prerequisites such as the matching Platoon Commander requiring its Regiment Troop remain separately enforced.

selectionEntries.name: Extra Unit Copy Costs

categoryLinks.name: Required Extra Unit Copy Costs Configuration

modifiers.value: Extra Unit Copy Costs is automatically managed by the listbuilder and should appear only once. Remove any extra Extra Unit Copy Costs entries.

selectionEntries.comment:
GS39 PRACTICE: Practice now uses the exact same Extra Unit Copy Cost branch as Quick: four normal-cost Troop copies and one normal-cost Other copy. The Practice branch below is derived from the current Quick branch; Standard and Long arithmetic are unchanged.

EXTRA UNIT COPY COSTS / GS37. Permanent required accounting entry. Troop and Other arithmetic remain logically separate but live directly on this single visible parent so New Recruit exports one surcharge line instead of repeating the aggregate through visible Troops / Other child ledgers. Normal-copy allowances are Practice 3 / 0, Quick 4 / 1, Standard 6 / 2, and Long 8 / 3 for Troop / Other respectively. Cadian Shock Troops, Death Korps Of Krieg, and Mordian Iron Guard remain the three Troop copy families. The existing eighteen non-Rare Other families retain the Other thresholds. Each excess identical copy adds 20 Points. At Practice, every Other unit copy therefore adds 20 Points immediately.

selectionEntries.comment:
CADIAN FINAL-STATE LOADOUT (REV6): compact model-accounting presentation. Loadout contains Sergeant, Cadian Shock Troopers 2-5 as fixed Lasguns, Cadian Shock Troopers 6-7 as the two paid special-weapon-capable models, and Weapon Specialist as the next model role with one free special-weapon choice. Special Weapons Team / Heavy Weapons Team is the final-state branch for the remaining two bodies: either Cadian Shock Troopers 9-10 as independently configured special-weapon-capable models, or one Heavy Weapons Team with a mandatory heavy weapon. The free specialist is labeled directly by role rather than as Cadian Shock Trooper 8.
REV8 WEAPON SPECIALIST DEFAULT: Player-facing Weapon Specialist slots no longer offer Lasgun. Grenade Launcher is the default free specialist weapon. Paid special-weapon-capable ordinary Guardsmen retain Lasgun because declining the paid upgrade remains a meaningful choice.
REV9 SPECIAL WEAPONS TEAM DEFAULT: Cadian Shock Troopers 9-10 under Special Weapons Team now omit Lasgun and default to Grenade Launcher, matching the dedicated Weapon Specialist treatment.

rules.name: Patch Notes
rules.description:
## Imperial Guard 3.3.6

## 3.3.6 Listbuilder Update

• Faction Name: Imperial Guard.
• Chimera: added Twin Autocannon as a turret weapon option.

*Full patch notes and rules can be found in the Reforged Discord Server: https://discord.gg/BpjkaNmMVB*

## Changelog (September 24th)

• Presentation: improved spacing after ◆ unit markers in roster exports.

## Changelog (September 23rd)

• 420 Point Practice: now uses 0 Leader Points and Quick-equivalent Extra Unit Copy Cost allowances; LP-costing units are hidden unless already selected.

## Changelog (September 21st)

• Standardized Configuration ordering and ◆ unit presentation.
• Platoon Commanders: Command Squads can now select both Bodyguards and both Weapons Specialists independently.
• Cleaned Additional Sentinel Model checkbox presentation for Scout and Armoured Sentinels.

## Changelog (September 19th)

• Added 420 Point Practice support and the current Unit Ability/list presentation.
• Optional abilities such as Smoke Launchers, APHE Shells, Explosive Mines, and Gas Dispersion now appear only with their matching upgrades.
• Manufactorum Imperium: synchronized to the current Imperial Guard vehicle roster, including conditional Unit Ability presentation.

## Changelog (September 16th)

• Kasrkins: corrected the five-model loadout tree.
• Tank Commander, Chimera, Taurox, Leman Russ Battle Tank, and Hellhound: integrated optional pintle weapons into Loadout Options.
• Leader Points added to six paid Leaders; Commissar and the eight Command Squad support Leaders remain 0 LP.
• Platoon Commander Command Squad presentation and linked-unit checkboxes were standardized.
• Scout and Armoured Sentinels: optional second models now use Additional Sentinel Model checkboxes.
• Death Korps Combat Engineer mines/grenades and common vehicle/wargear options were converted to checkbox-style selections.

selectionEntries.comment:
REV51 CHANGELOG CLEANUP. Renamed the player-facing maintenance history to Changelog and consolidated overlapping dated entries while preserving the detailed internal revision record. No list-construction mechanics changed.
REV42 CURRENT TEMPLATE. The September 19th Changelog section records only the actual player-facing delta from the live REV41 catalogue to the finished current-template state. Intermediate presentation experiments from other factions are implementation knowledge only and are not represented as Imperial Guard revisions. The September 16th historical section is preserved unchanged. REV44 fixes the duplicate shared-target collision in Platoon Commander Command Squads, allowing both Bodyguard slots and both Weapons Specialist slots to be selected simultaneously. REV45 adopts GS38 and the standardized Configuration ordering. REV46 adopts GS39 Practice: 0 LP, selected-safe hiding for LP-costing units, and Quick-equivalent copy thresholds. REV48 updates the faction to Imperial Guard 3.3.6 and adds the Chimera Twin Autocannon turret option. Other 3.3.6 changes are profile/statline changes not represented by this listbuilder.

catalogue.comment:
REV53 / GS40 — IMPERIAL GUARD TERMINOLOGY CLEANUP
Removed the final legacy faction-name wording from the catalogue documentation so the finished catalogue consistently uses `Imperial Guard`. No IDs, targets, points, LP, constraints, modifiers, associations, loadouts, category ownership, copy-cost arithmetic, Practice behavior, or other executable mechanics changed.

REV52 / GS40 — CURRENT-STATE DOCUMENTATION REFRESH
Corrected only the present-tense CURRENT STATE documentation to the live GS40 state. Practice copy allowances now reflect the GS39+ Quick-equivalent 4 Troop / 1 Other baseline where the stale GS37 text still described 3 / 0. Historical revision notes and separate shared-library/version references remain unchanged for their own audit passes. No IDs, targets, costs, LP objects or modifiers, constraints, associations, loadouts, category ownership, copy-cost arithmetic, Practice hiding logic, or other executable mechanics changed.

REV51 / GS40 — CHANGELOG CLEANUP
Renamed the player-facing maintenance history to Changelog, kept dated sections newest-first, and consolidated overlapping entries while preserving what changed and which units/systems were affected. Detailed implementation history remains in the catalogue comment. No IDs, targets, costs, LP, constraints, modifiers, associations, loadouts, category ownership, Regiment logic, Command Squad behavior, Sentinel behavior, Manufactorum source semantics, copy-cost arithmetic, or other executable mechanics changed.

REV50 / GS40 — IMPERIAL GUARD TERMINOLOGY SYNC
Updated all remaining legacy faction terminology to `Imperial Guard` throughout catalogue-owned player-facing text, comments, and historical documentation following the faction rename. No IDs, targets, costs, LP, constraints, modifiers, associations, loadouts, categories, copy-cost arithmetic, shared-root content, or other executable mechanics changed.

REV49 / GS40 — DIAMOND EXPORT SPACING
Added exactly one additional literal space after every diamond unit-marker character in catalogue-owned strings. Unit names and childName mirrors therefore remain synchronized. No IDs, targets, costs, LP, constraints, modifiers, associations, loadouts, category ownership, or other executable mechanics changed.

REV48 / GS40 — IMPERIAL GUARD 3.3.6
Faction renamed from Imperial Guard to Imperial Guard and version advanced to 3.3.6. Chimera gains one new free Twin Autocannon turret selection in its existing mandatory turret radio group. The 3.3.6 Demolisher Cannon type changes, Field Ordnance Battery / Heavy Lascannon Battery Health changes, Heavy Lascannon profile changes, and Death Korps Field Artillery Heavy Mortar profile changes are PDF statline data and are not duplicated by this listbuilder. Hellhound Grinding Tracks was already absent, so no executable removal was necessary. All pre-existing unit IDs, points, LP, loadouts, attachment behavior, Extra Unit Copy Cost arithmetic, Practice visibility, and unrelated catalogue mechanics are unchanged.

REV47 / GS40 — PRACTICE DESCRIPTION CLEANUP COMPATIBILITY
Retargeted to Game System revision 40 after removal of redundant construction-summary text from the 420 Point Practice description. No catalogue-local executable data changed in this revision: Practice LP visibility, explicit 0-LP attachment-only exceptions where present, Extra Unit Copy Cost arithmetic, points, IDs, loadouts, associations, and all unit mechanics remain unchanged.

REV46 / GS39 — PRACTICE ZERO-LP MIGRATION
This component now targets Game System revision 39. Every locally owned unit root carrying a positive LP cost receives selected-safe Practice hiding: it is hidden while 420 Point Practice is active only when that unit is not already selected. Explicit 0-LP roots do not exist under the project convention, so no exception tags are required. The local Extra Unit Copy Costs Practice branch is now an exact clone of the current Quick branch, giving Practice four normal-cost Troop copies and one normal-cost Other copy. Points, intrinsic LP costs, IDs, loadouts, associations, category ownership, Quick/Standard/Long arithmetic, and unrelated mechanics are unchanged.

CURRENT SYSTEM-WIDE CONFIGURATION ORDER / GS38
This catalogue now targets Game System revision 38. Configuration presentation follows the shared lane doctrine: provenance warning 5 when applicable; Game Size 10; army identity 20; optional army structure 30; Leader Points 40; faction trackers 50; Extra Unit Copy Costs 80; Updated 90; About 100. Only locally-owned applicable lanes are stored in this file; Game Size, Leader Points, and About are supplied by the Game System. No unit IDs, costs, constraints, modifiers, attachment topology, loadout legality, or copy-cost arithmetic were changed by this pass.

CURRENT STATE — IMPERIAL GUARD 3.3.6 / GS40
Complete playable catalogue using an explicit Regiment selector as a listbuilder presentation abstraction. Regiments of Cadia is the default. Regiment selection controls normal availability; matching Platoon Commander Troop prerequisites remain separately enforced. Cadian Shock Troops, Death Korps Of Krieg, and Mordian Iron Guard are independent Troop Extra Unit Copy Cost families. Non-Rare Other units use the normal Other ledger. Practice / Quick / Standard / Long normal-copy allowances are 4 / 4 / 6 / 8 for Troops and 1 / 1 / 2 / 3 for Other.

Command Squad members remain reusable complete nested Leader units beneath Platoon Commanders. They cost 0 Leader Points and are selected through direct linked-unit checkboxes. Commissar also costs 0 Leader Points; Commissar and Primaris Psyker retain mandatory Troops attachment validation. Cadian Platoon Commander, Death Korps Platoon Commander, Mordian Platoon Commander, Tank Commander, Enginseer Envoy, and Primaris Psyker each cost 1 LP. Tank Commander and Commissar remain Rare with constructive max-one errors. Kasrkins and Death Korps Grenadiers use permissive ratio validation instead of New Recruit stock maxima; Death Korps Combat Engineers use constructive prerequisite validation.

Sentinel units remain 1-2 models. The included model is presented as Sentinel and the optional second model as Additional Sentinel Model under the retained Additional Model model-header block; the max-one constraint remains on the optional model entry so New Recruit presents it as a checkbox. Smoke Launchers continue to scale by selected model count.

The eleven portable Imperial Guard vehicle trees in this catalogue remain the canonical source for the Manufactorum Imperium shared library. Manufactorum Imperium V16 mirrors those REV42 trees, including their current presentation and top-level Unit Ability profile links, while retaining library-specific non-primary category ownership and stable IDs.

AUTHORING / RUNTIME NOTES
The army-rules PDF and the supplied Unit Ability map remain authoritative for player-facing unit meaning. The listbuilder represents meaningful final-state choices rather than every procedural replacement step. Top-level Unit Ability names are represented as shared Profiles and linked to the appropriate unit trees; nested sub-abilities are intentionally omitted.

Unit rows use ◆ ; Loadout Options use 🧰; all model headers use the faction-default 🪖; and listbuilder-relevant Leader Attachment rules use 🔗. Regiment-gated units retain selected-safe hiding plus constructive wrong-Regiment validation. Command Squad member entryLinks remain type=unit because they are complete nested units. Duplicate Bodyguard and Weapons Specialist slots remain independent repeated checkboxes. Sentinel per-model Hunter-Killer Missiles remain model-owned. Explosive Mines, Remote Mine, grenade upgrades, and other independent binary wargear choices retain their established checkbox behavior.

OPTIONAL UNIT ABILITY PRESENTATION: top-level abilities granted by selectable upgrades are linked to the granting selection rather than the unit root. This applies to Smoke Launchers on Chimera, Taurox, Leman Russ Battle Tank, Scout Sentinels, Armoured Sentinels, Hellhound, Basilisk, Wyvern, and Manticore; Armour Piercing High Explosive Shells on Basilisk and Minotaur; Explosive Mines on Death Korps Combat Engineers; and Gas Dispersion on Field Artillery.

HISTORICAL / REVISION NOTES
REV1-9 — Established Regiment abstraction, Regiment Troops, Platoon Commanders, Command Squad pool, compact Troop loadouts, and specialist presentation.
REV10-18 — Added remaining Leaders, specialists, vehicles, artillery, Krieg units, completion-pass units, Regiment safe-hide behavior, and complete Additional Copy Cost coverage.
REV19-20 — Mature presentation polish; standardized Loadout Options, model headers, atomic package naming, vehicle presentation, and synchronized the then-current Astra vehicle presentation into Manufactorum.
REV21-22 — Adopted unified Troop / Other Additional Copy Costs and constructive dependency / ratio validation.
REV23-31 — Promoted Pintle Weapons, cleaned vehicle and specialist presentation, rebuilt Combat Engineer presentation, standardized role names, corrected Sergeant / Watchmaster loadouts, and suppressed redundant Sidearm / Melee headers.
REV32-35 — Applied Imperial Guard 3.3.4 Combat Engineer changes, standardized Patch Notes, then synchronized the baseline to Imperial Guard 3.3.5 / GS21.
REV36 — Flattened independent checkbox-style wargear and Command Squad member entryLinks while preserving stable IDs and semantics.
REV37 — Converted Scout / Armoured Sentinel optional second models to Additional Sentinel checkboxes, flattened Explosive Mines and Remote Mine, and consolidated live implementation comments.

REV38 — LEADER POINTS MIGRATION
Retargeted the catalogue to Game System revision 24. Cadian Platoon Commander, Death Korps Platoon Commander, Mordian Platoon Commander, Tank Commander, Enginseer Envoy, and Primaris Psyker now each cost 1 LP, exactly matching the six existing Counts Toward Leader Maximum roots. Commissar, Master Vox Operator, Standard Bearer, Medic, Bodyguard, Weapons Specialist, Master Of Ordnance, Officer Of The Fleet, and Astropath remain uncharged; their existing Leader Capacity rule objects were updated in place to the current source wording "This unit costs 0 leader points." No explicit 0 LP cost objects were added. The legacy count tags remain unchanged for parallel migration validation. Tank Commander is one of the canonical portable Astra vehicle roots; its new intrinsic LP cost will be synchronized into Manufactorum Imperium during the dedicated shared-library pass. Regiment selection, nested Command Squad structure, attachment limits, Rare validation, proportional restrictions, Additional Copy Costs, points, loadouts, Sentinel model-count behavior, and all unrelated mechanics are unchanged.

REV39 — LEADER POINTS CLEANUP + COMMAND SQUAD PRESENTATION
Runtime validation passed for a native paid Leader, an authoritative 0-LP Leader, and Tank Commander. The six legacy Counts Toward Leader Maximum links matched the six native 1-LP roots exactly and were removed. Commissar and the eight Command Squad support Leaders remain source-backed 0-LP Leaders with no LP cost objects. The Command Squad entryLinks under Cadian, Death Korps, and Mordian Platoon Commanders are now ordered shortest-name-first with alphabetical tie-breaking and duplicate entries kept adjacent; this changes presentation only. Patch Notes presentation was updated to the September 14th cleanup convention. No unit points, loadouts, attachment legality, quotas, Additional Copy Costs, Sentinel logic, mine logic, Manufactorum mirroring, or other faction mechanics changed.

REV40 — PINTLE LOADOUT INTEGRATION
Tank Commander, Chimera, Taurox, Leman Russ Battle Tank, and Hellhound no longer expose a separate top-level Pintle Weapons section. Each existing max-one selector object was moved intact to the bottom of the unit's existing Loadout Options model block and its wrapper label was suppressed. Chimera and Taurox now use Pintle Heavy Stubber / Pintle Storm Bolter because the removed header previously carried that context. IDs, constraints, costs, infoLinks, and selection semantics are unchanged. The same intrinsic vehicle-tree presentation was synchronized to Manufactorum Imperium V14. The touched catalogue was compatibility-only retargeted from GS24 to current GS26.

REV41 — KASRKIN MODEL COUNT FIX
Corrected the Kasrkin loadout presentation so the five visible model roles total exactly five bodies: Sergeant, Trooper 2, Trooper 3, Weapons Specialist, and Sharpshooter / Demo Trooper. The former two-model Trooper 2-3 block is now a single Trooper 2 with one Hot-Shot Lasgun; former Trooper 4 is now Trooper 3 and retains the same paid special-weapon selector. No IDs, points, constraints, categories, Leader Points, Additional Copy Cost arithmetic, attachments, or other listbuilding mechanics changed.
REV42 — CURRENT TEMPLATE / PRACTICE / UNIT ABILITIES / MANUFACTORUM SYNC
Consolidated current-template update from the live REV41 baseline. Retargeted the catalogue to Game System revision 37; added 420 Point Practice compatibility to Extra Unit Copy Costs; flattened the visible Troops/Other accounting children into one Extra Unit Copy Costs entry while preserving all existing Quick/Standard/Long arithmetic; adopted the current unit/loadout/model/category/attachment presentation; renamed the Sentinel optional second-model selections to the current semantic additional-model label; and added top-level Unit Ability profiles from the supplied Imperial Guard ability map. All eleven canonical portable Astra vehicle roots were synchronized into Manufactorum Imperium V16 with stable root IDs preserved. The visible September 19th Changelog section records only this actual delta.

REV43 — DIAMOND UNIT MARKERS / ADDITIONAL MODEL CLEANUP
Replaced remaining unit-row and linked-unit chevrons with ◆  throughout the Imperial Guard catalogue and synchronized mirrored childName metadata. The optional second-model entries for Scout Sentinels and Armoured Sentinels now use the plain label Additional Sentinel Model with no prefix marker. Existing 🪖 model headers, 🧰 Loadout Options, 🔗 Leader Attachment labels, themed Unit Ability profiles, Regiment gating, Game System category icons, Manufactorum source semantics, IDs, points, Leader Points, constraints, modifiers, conditional Unit Ability ownership, loadout legality, and Extra Unit Copy Cost arithmetic are unchanged.

REV44 — PLATOON COMMAND SQUAD DUPLICATE SLOT FIX
Cadian, Death Korps, and Mordian Platoon Commander Command Squads previously exposed two Bodyguard entryLinks targeting one shared Bodyguard root and two Weapons Specialist entryLinks targeting one shared Weapons Specialist root. Because each link carried a parent-scope max-one constraint, New Recruit treated the duplicate links as one underlying selection and selecting the second slot deselected the first. Added one mechanically identical shared Bodyguard clone and one mechanically identical shared Weapons Specialist clone with fresh internal IDs, then retargeted only the second slot in each Command Squad. Existing visible names, costs, loadouts, Leader Points, constraints, root entryLink IDs, presentation, and all unrelated Imperial Guard mechanics are unchanged.
